label: Godot 4
description: Godot 4.3+ native glTF import (editor import or runtime GLTFDocument). Meters, +Y up, models face +Z (Vector3.MODEL_FRONT); no conversion needed.
importHints: Drop the .glb into the Godot FileSystem dock (or load it at runtime with GLTFDocument).
Godot imports 3D textures as VRAM Compressed by default (lossy). For pixel-exact palettes or crisp detail set the texture import mode to Lossless, or keep VRAM Compressed with High Quality.
Base color factors map to StandardMaterial3D.albedo_color (converted to sRGB by the importer).

notes: 2026-10-01: node studio engine-verify godot on Godot 4.7.2 (official Linux build): 38/38 golden items passed — size and bounds, triangles, mesh/surface counts, node pivots, albedo (sRGB), alpha, metallic/roughness, texture slots, emission, transparency and culling match the export.

The same 38 items were rendered in Godot (Compatibility renderer, Xvfb) next to the studio viewport renders: shapes, proportions, UVs, textures and colors match; lighting differs as expected between renderers.
Godot converts baseColorFactor (linear) to an sRGB albedo_color on import; the check compares against the sRGB value.
Re-run after exporter or profile changes: node studio engine-verify godot (needs Godot 4.3+ on PATH or GODOT_BIN).
